text:
Simon Holmstrom is having the best stretch of his career, in a contract year. He extended his point streak to seven games, and our numbers call it a breakout: 18:05 a night, up from 16:44, on the ice for 48% of the Islanders' power-play chances after 19% last season, and 18 points in 23 games (0.78 a game, up from 0.52). His own chances are up too, to 0.88 expected goals per 60 from 0.66.

The goals are the part to handle carefully. He has ten on 6.1 expected, shooting 25% after 19% last season, and the Islanders have scored 4.8 more goals than expected with him on. That finishing rarely lasts. The team thinks he should shoot more, and with only 40 shots that's fair: volume is the way to keep scoring when the percentage dips. He carries the puck in on 57% of his entries in Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking. Our range projects 46 to 66 points, a big raise either way.
